about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for adk (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Item f of para 1.4 is run into the line of item e(ii) instead of standing as its own item.
findings.evidence: tree: "(ii) maximum height: 190mm If there are two or more rises to each row of seats, make each step an equal height. f In a tier"

findings.problem: Diagram 3.2 is printed at the top of the page, before the maintenance heading, but the tree puts it after para 3.5 under 'Guarding of areas used for maintenance'.
findings.evidence: tree heading_path: "Guarding of areas used for maintenance > For all buildings > Typical locations for guarding"

findings.problem: Diagram 4.2 (barrier design for para 4.2, vehicle barriers) is printed at the top of the page but the tree places it under 'Guarding for loading bays' after para 4.4.
findings.evidence: tree heading_path: "Guarding for loading bays > For all buildings > Barrier design"

findings.problem: Diagram 4.2 labels from the two drawings are interleaved line by line, so the label lines are mixed up, though all the words and numbers are there.
Diagram 9.1 is not kept as a figure: its labels and dimensions are a text block wrongly titled 'Safe access methods', and its caption is merged into item a of para 9.1.
findings.evidence: source: "Diagram 9.1 Safe reaches for cleaning" / tree: "...see BS 8213-1. See para 9.1 Diagram 9.1 Safe reaches for cleaning"

findings.problem: Diagram 9.2 caption fragments with stray characters are merged into item b(ii) of para 9.1.
findings.evidence: tree: "as shown in Diagram 9.3. See para 9.1b(i) m mro Diagram 9.2 Ladders a maximum of 6m long"
